item.title: Nish's Daily Reads — 2026-08-11
item.description: I opened six strong primary or near-primary sources from 232 candidates. The clearest signal was practical AI: local models are getting small enough to run on devices, while businesses are learning to control AI costs and permissions. I dropped the rest for weak proof, repetition, or engineering detail without a founder-level consequence.
